title: wait-idle pauses until network requests settle

title: Passe logs which Chrome it connected to and how

brief.why: PASSE_CDP can silently point at a remote Chrome (e.g. Mac via tailscale) while the operator assumes local headless. We wasted an entire debugging session attributing network transfer latency to compositor stalls because nothing in passe output identified the actual browser. DPR=2 (Retina) was a clue but only in hindsight.
brief.what: 1. On connect, fetch /json/version and log the Browser string, webSocketDebuggerUrl, and resolved host to stderr 2. Include the CDP endpoint URL in the run summary JSON (e.g. 'cdp': 'http://100.66.153.39:9222') 3. If the host is not localhost/127.0.0.1, emit a visible note like '[passe] remote Chrome: sameer-macbook-air.atlas-cloud.ts.net:9222' so it's impossible to miss 4. Add the browser UA and DPR to screenshot output breakdown so capture time can be interpreted correctly
